context: The inverted index end to end (Manning/Raghavan/Schutze chs 1-2,4,5 territory). Teach text processing as DECISION scenarios (when stemming hurts precision, stop words vs phrase queries). Index construction: blocked builds + merging (lean on external merge sort from IR 100), logarithmic merge for dynamic updates. Compression essentials only: delta gaps + variable-byte; the "Postings Compression vs Parquet Encodings" topic is a deliberate bridge that DE 201 reactivates.
